Made in Britain. Trusted by the Trade.
Solving the unsolvable in blinds – since 1753
View All Products
ABOUT US
Above average
Not your average blinds supplier.
Hopkins quietly solves the blind and shading jobs others can't.
From rare fittings to full systems, we design and supply the parts and solutions that don't exist off the shelf and haven't for 270+ years.

Hopkins products are built to last. The service is personal and dependable. No fluff. No shortcuts. No cheap fixings. Just solid engineering, well-made parts, and customers who come back because they trust what they're buying.

But we're more than just long-standing. We're inventive. We take on the tricky stuff – awkward spans, heritage properties, film sets, yachts, you name it. When others say “it can’t be done,” we build the answer – properly, and without fuss.
This is British-made, trade-trusted blinds and fittings, built to last, and built to work.
Give us a call and speak to one of our experts
HERITAGE
Solving the unsolvable in blinds - since 1753
HOPKINS is Britain's oldest manufacturer of blinds, blinds parts, and shading solutions — a trusted name in the trade since 1753.

The Hopkins team

From our headquarters in Biggleswade, Bedfordshire, the Hopkins team brings together decades of engineering expertise, industry knowledge, and a passion for exceptional customer service. We work closely with manufacturers, installers, and trade professionals to deliver high-quality blind components, bespoke solutions, and reliable technical support.
With a commitment to precision, innovation, and long-lasting partnerships, we're proud to help customers across the UK achieve outstanding results on every project.
David Hopkins
Managing Director

With decades of industry experience, David leads Hopkins with a commitment to quality, innovation, and long-term customer partnerships. His focus is ensuring every product meets the highest manufacturing standards.
James Carter
Operations Director
James oversees day-to-day operations, production planning, and supply chain management, ensuring orders are delivered accurately, efficiently, and on time.
Sarah Mitchell
Engineering Manager
Sarah works closely with customers to develop custom blind hardware and engineered solutions that meet unique project requirements with precision.
Laura Bennett
Customer Support Manager
Laura ensures every customer receives responsive, knowledgeable support—from product enquiries to after-sales assistance.
Michael Turner
Sales Manager
Michael helps customers select the right components and provides expert technical guidance for both standard and bespoke applications.
Tom Richardson
Production Supervisor
Tom manages the manufacturing floor, maintaining strict quality control and ensuring every component leaving Hopkins is built to last.
Products

Discover an extensive range of high-quality blind components, fittings, brackets, pulleys, tubes, and specialist hardware. Every product is manufactured to deliver exceptional durability, reliability, and performance across residential, commercial, and heritage applications.
Search
Custom Solutions

Every project is different. Our experienced engineering team works closely with customers to design and manufacture bespoke components and complete blind systems tailored to unique specifications, ensuring the perfect fit for every application.
Explore
Hopkins

Since 1753, Hopkins has built a reputation for innovation, craftsmanship, and engineering excellence. Combining centuries of heritage with modern manufacturing technology, we continue to provide trusted solutions for blind professionals across the UK and beyond.
